OSINTdefender Denmark says it has foiled an assassination attempt of an American-Ukrainian citizen, the rapper known as Kyivstoner, on Danish soil that it assesses was initiated by Russian intelligence services. In a statement, Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET) and the Danish National Police prevented an attempt on an American Ukrainian citizen, to be carried out by people associated with the banned gang Loyal to Familia (LTF). Danish broadcaster DR identified the target as the Ukrainian American rapper Kyivstoner. Two Danish men were arrested shortly before he was due to perform in Charlottenlund, outside Copenhagen, on September 25th. Both men deny wrongdoing and have been remanded in custody, according to DR. PET’s director said it was the agency’s clear assessment that Russian intelligence services planned the attempt. Denmark will expel Russia’s defense attaché in response. Frederiksen said Denmark will increase support for Ukraine with its allies and toughen sanctions on Russia, including halting all non essential visas to Russian citizens. Portishead’s music has reportedly disappeared from streaming platforms in Israel.
